verdict.rationale: Deepgram is API-first. Its core capabilities (pre-recorded and streaming transcription, voice agents, audio intelligence, callbacks) are all documented as API endpoints or parameters, and a published OpenAPI spec exists. The dg CLI also manages projects, API keys, team members and usage, which suggests account-administration operations are programmatically accessible. However, no evidence explicitly claims or demonstrates full parity between the console UI and the API. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of console/API parity, evidence that account and billing management is exposed directly in the REST API rather than only via the CLI, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI
